text: {"question":"How has the quoted value of the Hubble constant derived from the Planck cosmic microwave background data evolved between the earlier and later studies?","reference_answer":"The earlier study reported H0 = 67.24 ± 0.35 km s⁻¹ Mpc⁻¹ from Planck data, while the later study updated this to H0 = 67.36 ± 0.54 km s⁻¹ Mpc⁻¹, indicating a slight increase in the central value and a modestly larger uncertainty."}
